title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Semis ripped, broad tape stalled.
SOXX +2.40% and QQQ +0.81% carried the day while SPY finished -0.02% and XLF -1.97%, with only 28% of S&P names above their 50-DMA. Money is chasing AI hardware via SMH (+$3.68B, 100th pct) and abandoning SPY (-$22.9B, 0th pct) — a narrow, conviction-short market where index beta is being sold to fund semis.

INDICES — VIX 14.2, below its 20-day MA of 15.6, near the 52-week low of 13.5.
SOXX +2.40%, QQQ +0.81%, IWM +0.57%, SPY -0.02%, DIA -0.34%. Large > small by 0.24pp — but IWM's 1.3x volume against IJR's 0.7x says small-cap *quality* bid, not small-cap breadth. Nat gas +5.85% was the standout cross-asset move; WTI -2.75% the laggard. SPY at 774.21 sits 3.0% below its GEX flip of 778.0 — a CTA-sensitive zone.

VOLUME & BREADTH — QQQ 1.2x and IWM 1.3x on price gains = accumulation; SPY 0.8x on a flat close = indecision at the index level. XLY and XLK each at 1.3x confirms rotation, not liquidation. Breadth diverges hard: 49% advancers, up/down volume 0.95, and 76 new 60-day lows versus 16 highs — participation does NOT confirm the index move. This is a narrow mega-cap/semis tape, not a broad rally.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLB Materials +1.65%, XLP Staples +0.99%, XLK Technology +0.73%, XLV Healthcare +0.52%, XLI Industrials +0.17%, XLY Discretionary +0.09%, XLRE Real Estate -0.21%, XLU Utilities -0.32%, XLC Comms -1.06%, XLE Energy -1.09%, XLF Financials -1.97%.
Top industries: MSOS +7.89% and GDX +3.60%; bottom: USO -2.75% and XOP -1.70%. Flows contradict the price ranking: XLF led outflows at -$697mm (17th pct) while XLB, the day's best sector, saw no listed inflow. Real money is in semis (SMH +$3,680mm, 100th pct) and mid/small core (IJH +$2,360mm, IJR +$1,534mm), not the sector leaders. AI hardware leading.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 0.64 and ATM IV 8.9% signal complacency despite the skew at +4.4%; QQQ PCR 3.03 is an outlier, likely heavy put structures colliding with the flip at 750.0 versus spot 741.01. VIXEQ 39.1 (above its 36.6 MA) versus VIX 14.2 is a wide gap — low implied correlation, high single-stock dispersion, a rotation tape. MOVE prints 0.0, so no bond-vol stress read.

CROSS-ASSET — Nat gas +5.85% and silver +1.84% both bid while WTI -2.75% and XLE -1.09% bled — a clear energy-equity-to-precious/commodity rotation. Dollar flat (UUP 0.00%) means no FX translation story. Next FOMC Oct 28: CME FedWatch shows hike 100.0%; Polymarket prices 52% for a 25bp hike versus 46% no change (+3pp in 5 days).

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 48.9, Neutral. LEN +6.38% on Q3 earnings (orders -9%), MU +5.00% on news, ADBE -4.52% on a bear note. Vol spikes: FNGS 4.9x on +0.43% (churn, not accumulation) and PGR 2.3x on -2.50% (distribution). Watch UNG (+5.85%, 2.9x vol) for commodity follow-through, MSOS (+7.89%, 2.4x) for a momentum break, and QQQ against its 750.0 gamma flip with spot at 741.01.
